de.abas.jfop.base.buffer

Interface SelectableBuffer

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BaseReadableBuffer, Buffer, DbObjectBuffer, LoadableBuffer, MetadataSupport, ReadableBuffer, TableEnabledBuffer, WriteableBuffer
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    LoadBuffer, LockableBuffer, SelectBuffer

    public interface SelectableBuffer
extends DbObjectBuffer, TableEnabledBuffer, LoadableBuffer
    Every FO buffer which may be used for selecting records implements this interface.

      • moveToSelectedRow

        boolean moveToSelectedRow()
                   throws FOPException
        Moves the buffer cursor to the table row which has been selected by a query. If there was no table query the header is selected.

        Throws:
        FOPException

        throws FOPException
        Selects a system info entry.
        Parameters:

      • selectRecord

        boolean selectRecord(String recordID)
              throws FOPException
        Starts a selection on this buffer (if allowed) for reading. The record is loaded and no BufferSelection object is created. The record ID must not be null. Otherwise a NullPointerException is thrown.
        Parameters:
        recordID - The record ID.
        Returns:
        If the record exists and has been successfully loaded.
        Throws:
        FOPException
